name: dcd-lsp
description: D language support via DCD's built-in LSP server

dcd.serverPath.description: Path to the dcd-server executable. When set to 'dcd-server' it is looked up on the PATH.

dcd.importPaths.description: Import paths passed to the server (in addition to dcd.conf). Relative paths are resolved against the workspace root.

dcd.ignoreConfig.description: Skip loading the DCD configuration file (dcd.conf).

dcd.logLevel.description: Log level passed to dcd-server (verbose server logs go to the D (DCD) output channel).

dcd.dscannerPath.description: Path to the D-Scanner executable for lint diagnostics. When set to 'dscanner' it is looked up on the PATH; set to an empty string to disable linting.

dcd.dscannerConfig.description: Path to a dscanner.ini configuration file to control which checks are enabled. Empty = dscanner discovers a dscanner.ini at the project root automatically.

dcd.dfmtPath.description: Path to the dfmt executable for code formatting. When set to 'dfmt' it is looked up on the PATH; set to an empty string to disable formatting.

enumDescriptions: One True Brace Style — braces on the same line: void foo() {
Braces on their own line: void foo() then { on the next line
Like OTBS, but else on its own line
Function braces on their own line, control-flow braces on the same line
dcd.dfmtBraceStyle.markdownDescription: Brace style used by dfmt when the project has no `.editorconfig`. A project `.editorconfig` (with `dfmt_brace_style`) always takes precedence. 'default' uses dfmt's built-in behavior.

dcd.autoModuleDeclaration.description: Automatically add (or fix) the module declaration of files newly created in the editor, matching the file's path-derived module name. The edit is undoable.
